CardDescription.DefaultText: Low-lying wetland flats dominated by alder trees, with patches of exposed clay ideal for digging.

CardHelpSection.DefaultText: Alder Clearing, Wetlands, Riverbank: Conditions: Acidic and humid soil. Flora: Alders, Bog Myrtle, Kingcup, Forest Caps, Spirit Mushrooms. Fauna: Frogs, Mosquitoes. Also: A clay-rich mound along the bank can be dug for raw clay.
